scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build --prefix backend && concurrently --names "frontend,electron" --prefix-colors "magenta,green" --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run electron:launch-dev"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --publish never
scripts.electron:publish: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --publish always
